mapper.select: select SEQ_NO SEQ_NO, FILE_NAME FILE_NAME, PATH PATH, BUSINESS_ID BUSINESS_ID, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME from SYS_UPLOAD_FILE_INFO where SEQ_NO = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into SYS_UPLOAD_FILE_INFO (SEQ_NO, FILE_NAME, PATH, BUSINESS_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
